meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Emacs 并想直接在编辑器里与 AI 交互
copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 装上后,你可以在 Emacs 编辑器里直接和 Claude 对话。它会把聊天窗口、org 文件里的文字当作输入,把回复以子标题或格式化文本显示在原文里。适合边写代码边提问、做代码审查、整理会议记录等。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 里按快捷键打开聊天缓冲区,或对 org 文档执行发送命令时触发。

say.text: 这段函数为什么会报错?帮我看看
say.note: 在聊天缓冲区发送,Claude 会回复解答。

say.text: 把我选中的代码区域发给你,做代码审查
say.note: 选中区域后发送,回复作为子标题显示。

say.text: 把当前 org 标题下的内容整理成行动清单
say.note: 发送 org 内容,Claude 返回清单节点。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can talk to Claude directly from Emacs. It accepts chat-buffer messages and org file regions as input, and shows replies as child headings or formatted text in place. Useful for coding questions, code review, and meeting notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you open the chat buffer with a keybinding or use the org send command in Emacs.

say_en.text: Why is this function erroring? Help me look.
say_en.note: Sent in chat buffer; Claude replies.

say_en.text: Send the selected code region for review.
say_en.note: Reply appears as a child heading.

say_en.text: Turn this org heading into an action list.
say_en.note: Claude returns a list as a child node.
